entry_rationale: Rates isolate BoC repricing from 2.30 without USD-oil contamination in USDCAD. Existing U7 at 4.94 is 19bp through 4.75, so reduce that pay and open the cleaner CAD pay.
entry_thesis: Brent 105.28 and WTI 92.60 with Iran-deal pessimism keep inflation sticky while BoC cash still sits at an easy 2.30 and SOFR cash at 3.90 only reaches 4.40 by Z6. Sep-27 SOFR at 4.94 already prices 104bp of tightening and is 19bp through the 4.75 pay, so late-2027 USD is no longer the cleanest hawkish marginal. Reduce that U7 pay into the extension and shift the residual into paying Mar-27 CORRA at 3.125, where policy is still accommodative into the same energy shock.

events.rationale: Rates isolate BoC repricing from 2.30 without USD-oil contamination in USDCAD. Existing U7 at 4.94 is 19bp through 4.75, so reduce that pay and open the cleaner CAD pay.

invalidation: Iran-deal pessimism lifts and Brent/WTI reverse sharply from 105.28/92.60, letting BoC stay near 2.30 and sending U7 back through 4.75; or a yen-warning risk-off duration bid that cheapens pays without a hawkish policy rethink.
